name: Health & Wellbeing
description: How WASH affects disease, stress, dignity, mental health, physical strain, nutrition, and access to care.

name: Infrastructure & Technology
description: Pipes, pumps, toilets, latrines, treatment plants, testing tools, transport systems, maintenance, and design choices.

name: Governance, Finance & Institutions
description: Policies, agencies, tariffs, funding, accountability, regulation, public/private roles, and who is responsible for keeping systems working.

name: Culture, History & Place
description: Sacred sites, local beliefs, colonial history, national identity, land, memory, and how people give meaning to water, sanitation, and development.

name: Gender, Equity & Safety
description: Unequal WASH burdens, women's labour, safety, GBV, menstruation, class, age, access, dignity, and who is included in decision-making.

name: Climate, Environment & Ecosystems
description: Flooding, drought, forests, watersheds, pollution, biodiversity, land use, climate variability, and environmental protection.

name: Livelihoods & Economy
description: Farming, markets, household income, costs of water/sanitation, productivity, tourism, food systems, and economic survival.

name: Data, Knowledge & Collaboration
description: Water testing, monitoring, research, community knowledge, storytelling, photo-elicitation, peer learning, partnerships, and knowledge mobilization.
